system.description:
Crystal Release: Crystal Wheel · cast at S-Rank · no type

+60 speed; you ignore difficult and special terrain.

A creature that makes an opportunity attack against you takes 6d6 earth damage.

Advantage on saving throws against effects that affect an area.

The first time each turn you move within 5 feet of a hostile creature, or it moves within 5 feet of you, it takes 4d6 earth damage.
